summary: Ebang International Holdings Inc. filed a Form 6-K to report its unaudited financial results for the first half of fiscal year 2026. The filing details revenues of approximately US$3.92 million, a 9.54% increase year-over-year, gross profit of US$0.73 million, and a net loss of US$5.54 million. The announcement includes commentary from Chairman and CEO Dong Hu regarding strategic focus on renewable energy, electric power equipment, and digital infrastructure. No special-situation transaction, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or tender offer, is described. The filing is a routine earnings release, not a special situation.
